hidden_setting.paper_setting: Table 3(a), Appendix B.4: full-depth multiple-choice hidden-state guidance
hidden_setting.intervention: Combine raw completed recurrent states at every sequence position before native pre-coda ln_f; retain complete ln_f -> coda -> ln_f -> lm_head readout.

protocol.attention_count: Dense QK and AV matrix products, no causal triangle discount.
protocol.counted: Attention and MLP matrices, recurrent injection, coda, and vocabulary head.
protocol.excluded: Embedding lookup, normalization, RoPE, activations, biases, residual additions, and guidance vector arithmetic.
protocol.guidance_vector_arithmetic: Reported separately; not added to the matrix-product FLOP total.
protocol.paper_source: sources/looped_qwen/loopcd.html, Appendix D.1 and Table A7

flops_512_token_prefill.accounting_difference: The paper's printed Huginn TFLOPs match Transformer blocks and head with dense attention, excluding the recurrent 2d-to-d injection matrix. Both ledgers are retained.
flops_512_token_prefill.hidden_guidance_cost: Hidden guidance has the same matrix products as baseline and one complete coda/head. It additionally captures the reference state and blends raw recurrent states over the full sequence; these operations can affect measured latency and memory.

methodology.selection: Sort all task candidates by input length, question index, and choice index; use eight-candidate slices centered at length quantiles 0.25, 0.50, and 0.75.
methodology.scope: Independent standalone teacher-forced answer-token likelihood scoring at the same recurrent depth.
methodology.hidden_intervention: Blend full-sequence raw recurrent states before pre-coda normalization; perform one complete coda and vocabulary head.
methodology.timed_operations: Input validation, initial-state clone, embedding, prelude, recurrence, policy-specific readout and guidance, log_softmax, and target gather; perf_counter with CUDA synchronization before and after.
methodology.excluded_from_policy_timing: Checkpoint loading, tokenizer/data preparation, tensor construction/transfer, initial random-state generation/transfer, warmup, and serialization.
methodology.initial_state_handling: Identical precomputed per-question initial states supplied to every independent policy forward; normal CPU generation plus GPU transfer is separately timed and checked.
methodology.initial_state_storage: All three precomputed batch states remain on GPU during measurements.
methodology.output_projection: Full vocabulary at answer-predicting positions only.
methodology.order: Repetition r rotates batch order by r; batch b rotates policy order by r+b. Each call performs a separate forward.
methodology.aggregate: Sum one latency from each sampled batch per repetition, then report median, quartiles and MAD. Ratios compare policy aggregate medians.
methodology.interpretation: Sampled scoring latency; Hidden has unchanged matrix-product FLOPs but additional reference capture and vector operations.
